# jobrunner

Small job runner with a pluggable retry policy.

## Retry policy

`run_job` accepts a configurable bounded exponential retry policy. The
`max_attempts` value includes the first call. Only `RetryError::Transient`
errors are retried; `RetryError::Permanent` errors return immediately, and the
last transient error is returned when the attempt budget is exhausted.

Set `base_delay_ms` for the delay before the first retry and `max_delay_ms` for
the upper bound. Retry delays double after each transient failure and saturate
at `max_delay_ms`, including when values are large enough that doubling would
overflow. Delays are provided through the injected `Sleeper`, so callers can
supply real or test-time waiting behavior.
